packageRules.description: bunfig.toml pins install.exact = true, so every dependency in package.json is already an exact version — bump in place rather than widening to a range.
Group Biome lint/format updates together — they version in lockstep and a partial bump between biome.json's schema and @biomejs/biome tends to break `bun run check`.

TypeScript is pinned to the 7.x prerelease line on purpose (see CLAUDE.md's tech stack table) — don't let Renovate silently jump major/minor without a human looking, since @typescript-eslint-style tooling elsewhere in the ecosystem often lags new TS releases.
Vite and its dts plugin need to move together — vite-plugin-dts pins to a Vite major internally.
